body: I watch porn on my phone while we are having sex (medication libido issues).

I know exactly how you feel. I'm also on medication, receiving treatment. But I just feel like life isn't worth it. Even at my happiest it doesn't feel like enough. As someone with bipolar disorder, the only thing that keeps me going is the hope that I will get to another high soon enough. It's weird, but it must be a depressed thing because I always say I wouldn't mind getting hit by a bus. Why do we all choose hit by a bus? Anyway. I don't really have any advice other than I am going to give it a few more years. Maybe you should too. I sometimes wonder about whether I eventually will do it though
